input: Hire a dog walker for the upcoming work trip

gold.taskTitle: Hire a Dog Walker for Upcoming Work Trip
gold.taskDescription: Find and hire a reliable dog walker to care for the user's dog while they are away on a work trip.

questions.title: What are the exact dates you will be away?
questions.description: Understand the start and end dates of the work trip to determine the duration of dog walking coverage needed.

questions.title: How many dogs need walking and what breeds?
questions.description: Identify the number of dogs and their breeds to match with a walker experienced with those specific animals.

questions.title: How many walks per day does your dog need?
questions.description: Determine the frequency and duration of walks required each day during the trip.

questions.title: Do you need drop-in visits or full-time boarding too?
questions.description: Clarify whether the dog walker only needs to visit for walks or also stay with or board the dog.

questions.title: Have you used a dog walking service before?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preferred platform, app, or person in mind, such as Rover or Wag, or a trusted individual.

questions.title: Are there special needs or behaviors to consider?
questions.description: Identify any medical conditions, dietary requirements, aggression, anxiety, or other behavioral traits the walker must be prepared for.

questions.title: What is your budget per walk or per day?
questions.description: Establish a budget range to narrow down suitable dog walking options and avoid services that are out of range.
